ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
In this sheet several scenes show the FLIGHT of a golf ball as a thin, bright white dotted trail in the air above the little slab of ground; draw the trail clearly. Row 1: (1) three red flags standing at increasing distances down a strip of fairway, a white ball lying close to each one; (2) a white dotted ball trail that bends in a clear curve around a single tall tree to reach a flag behind it; (3) two white dotted trails from one tee: one very high arc going over a tree, one low flat line going under its branches; (4) a rusty old car wreck on rough ground used as a target, golf balls scattered around it and one dented panel.
Row 2: (5) a ball sitting in long fringe grass just off a green, a wedge lying beside it, the flag only a short way off; (6) a putter lying on a green, a ball, and a white dotted line curving gently across the green into the hole; (7) a ball half buried in a sand bunker with a sand wedge and a wooden rake; (8) a white dotted ball trail curving smoothly from RIGHT to LEFT over a fairway toward a flag.
Row 3: (9) a white dotted ball trail curving smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT over a fairway toward a flag; (10) one very tall, steep white dotted arc rising high above a tee and dropping onto a green; (11) one very low, flat white dotted trail skimming just above the grass under a row of tree branches; (12) a ball on a green beside its flag with a short curled white trail behind it showing it spinning backwards.
generator: ChatGPT image generation through the chatgpt-bridge (D:/AI/chatgpt-bridge), 2026-11-14
lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
processing: Native generator output copied byte-for-byte (the generatorSource file has the same sha256); no repaint, resample, mirror, recolour or transform. Cut by scripts/assets/prep-ui-tool-tiles.mjs (version v6) into 144 px rounded WebP tiles in src/assets/ui/tiles/; crop rectangles and hashes in art/ui-tool-tiles/sheet-v6.json.
